# honeyd.me

> A profile-photo frame maker in the style of professional-network "open to work" badges. Images are processed entirely in the browser and are never uploaded.

## About

honeyd.me composites a decorative frame onto a profile photo. You choose a
photo, the frame is applied on your own device, and you download the result.
No photo is uploaded, stored, or transmitted off the browser.

## Usage

- There is no public API and no dataset.
- Content on this site is not offered for model training or scraping.
- Please respect /robots.txt.
